responsibility: Declares the generic directed-graph data model used by diagnostics metadata. It defines diagnostics::digraphs::digraph, node, and edge, plus the shared property-bag-bearing object base class, supporting nested child nodes, cross-node edges, logical and physical locations, SARIF graph/node/edge conversion entry points, and .dot generation hooks; this is the core graph abstraction that later files specialize for analyzer state graphs.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the digraphs pair: it defines the generic diagnostics::digraphs object, digraph, node, and edge classes and their public API for nested nodes, edges, locations, and serialization hooks. Unlike digraphs.cc, it does not implement cloning, property access, SARIF conversion, .dot generation, or tests.
